Plenty of benefits

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=””]In addition to clean, fresh air, PlasmaMade E-Filters offer many more advantages.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=”” el_class=”checked-list-success”]

  • Energy saving through recirculation
  • Sustainable: 97% recyclable
  • Mounted in no time, twist-clamp closure
  • Lifespan 10 to 15 years
  • Less noise, more peace
  • Entire lifespan 100% quality without degeneration
  • Small size, also suitable for design hoods
  • Large air passage: Energy-efficient
  • Worldwide certification
  • Fast and effective elimination of fine dust

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_column_text css=””]

Find your filter
